Upon reflection, this was a category error. The user prompt explicitly requested 'kangaroos', not 'wallabies'. The image successfully generated kangaroos. The taxonomy mismatch is relevant for biological accuracy checks but should not penalize the basic 'presence' of the requested object. The fine-grained classifier's identification of 'wallaby' (a type of kangaroo) further supports that the object class is correct. I also adjusted the authenticity score slightly upward (4.2 -> 4.3) after re-evaluating the severity of the toe fusion; it is a localized defect on a stylized statue and does not significantly detract from the overall high-quality metallic rendering.
